static_functions.name: HoldConnection
static_functions.description: Holds a connecting player in the loading screen with a message, before he starts downloading the server files
static_functions.description_details:
Only works from inside the PlayerConnect event, or on a connection already held, which only updates its message (e.g. his position in your queue). The player waits until you call Server.ReleaseConnection() or kick him, which lets you verify him asynchronously (database, web API) or build your own queue.

Held players are not counted in max_players nor shown in the server list. If the server is full, new connections only get in up to max_held_connections from the Config.toml, which is 0 by default (full servers refuse new players)

return.description: If the connection is now held

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Plain text shown in the loading screen, up to 256 bytes

static_functions.name: ReleaseConnection
static_functions.description: Lets a held player in, he starts downloading the server files and joins as usual
static_functions.description_details: Returns false if the server is full (max_players is always respected) or the player is not held, in which case he stays held

return.description: If the player was let in

events.name: Start
events.description: Triggered once when the server has started and all packages are loaded

events.name: Restart
events.description: Triggered when the server is restarting

events.name: ChangeMap
events.description_details: This is always called just before Restart event

events.name: PlayerConnect
events.description: Called when a player is attempting to connect to the server, after Steam authenticated him
events.description_details:
It is called before the Player entity is created and before he starts downloading the server files.

To refuse the connection, call Server.KickBySteamID() or Server.BanBySteamID() with the player_steam_id (returning false is deprecated). To decide later (e.g. after an asynchronous check, or to make him wait in a queue), call Server.HoldConnection()

events.name: PlayerDisconnect
events.description: Called when a player is disconnecting from the server
events.description_details: It is also called for players who never fully connected, including the ones held with Server.HoldConnection()

events.name: Stop
events.description: Triggered when the server is stopping

events.name: Tick
events.description_details: Caution: Only small operations should be performed here, otherwise this can lead to server lag and delays

events.name: PackageLoad
events.description: Triggered when any package is loaded

events.name: PackageUnload
events.description: Triggered when any package is unloaded

events.name: ValueChange
events.description: Triggered when a Value is changed with Server.SetValue()
